scope: Strict owned absolute HTTP(S) URL parsing, request association, bounded explicit DNS and sequential connection orchestration; local source candidates only
profile: Only absolute http/https, LDH DNS, strict IPv4 and bracketed unscoped IPv6; ports 1..65535
Normalize scheme/DNS case, IP text/default port and empty path; omit validated fragments; preserve path/query escapes and dot segments without decoding
Reject userinfo, trailing-dot DNS, IDNA conversion, legacy numeric IP, raw controls/non-ASCII/backslash, malformed escapes and routing/framing overrides
Generate Host and Content-Length; derive HTTPS SNI/certificate identity from the same URL; reject conflicting peer, ALPN and scheme before dialing
Caller-owned bounded AsyncResolver with call-local notification loop; numeric bypass and sequential OS-order attempts, no per-attempt deadline reset
Preserve original absolute controls through DNS/connect/TLS/body/shutdown; preserve typed Resolve/Connect errors; recheck controls before numeric dial errors and resolution result publication
Blocked OS DNS can outlive control return and retains its bounded slot until worker completion/Poll; release/recovery verified in the same pool
Ordinary native inputs for live/production consumers; separate test DNS adapter/getaddrinfo gate only for controlled failure consumers; plain HTTP remains free of TLS inputs
remaining: Relative-reference resolution, IDNA/trailing-dot policy beyond the strict profile
Happy Eyeballs and deterministic failed-first address fallback evidence
DNS notification allocation/native faults and exhaustive scheduling/resource interleavings
